description: Abstract class defining leave allocation logic for HR management, including overlap detection, leave duration calculation, and work shift validation.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationService
classes.description: Defines core leave allocation operations, including overlap detection, leave validation, and leave request generation.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to save a leave request and send notifications.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Abstract method to determine the status of a leave request based on day type and leave parameters.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Abstract method to check if leave balance can be exceeded.

methods.name: getHashKeyForLeaveParamObject
methods.description: Generates a unique hash key for a given leave parameter object.

methods.name: getOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves overlapping leave requests for a given leave parameter, considering partial days and work schedule.

methods.name: hasOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Checks if there are any overlapping leaves for the given leave parameters.

methods.name: isEmployeeAllowedToApply
methods.description: Determines if an employee is permitted to apply for a specific leave type.

methods.name: isWorkShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the total leave hours exceed the employee's work shift length on any day within the leave period.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLengthExceedOverlapLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests that exceed work shift length within overlapping leave dates.

methods.name: generateLeaveRequest
methods.description: Creates a new LeaveRequest object based on leave parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDurationForEmployee
methods.description: Returns the work shift length for a specific employee.

methods.name: getApplicableLeaveDuration
methods.description: Determines the applicable leave duration (full day, half day, specific time) based on leave parameters and position within multi-day leave.

methods.name: updateLeaveDurationParameters
methods.description: Sets leave duration type, start/end times, and hours based on day type and leave duration.

methods.name: addHoursDuration
methods.description: Adds specified hours to a DateTime object, returning a new DateTime.

methods.name: getDurationInHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: createLeaveObjectListForAppliedRange
methods.description: Generates a list of Leave objects for each day in the leave application range, setting duration and status.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Determines if a specific day is a half-day leave based on work schedule.

methods.name: isWeekend
methods.description: Checks if a day is a weekend according to the employee's work schedule.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfdayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a day is a half-day holiday.
